Package com.example.eventlottery.domain

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.domain.Event
public class Event extends Object
Event domain model for organizer-created events. Responsibilities: - store event details such as name, description, organizer, dates, and capacity - store event configuration options such as geolocation requirement - store co-organizer device IDs for shared event management - convert event data into a Firestore-friendly map User stories supported: - US 02.01.01: Create a new public event with a promotional QR code - US 02.01.02: Create a private event - US 02.01.04: Set a registration period - US 02.02.03: Enable or disable the geolocation requirement for an event - US 02.09.01: Add co-organizers to an event
Version:
1.6
Author:
Kenneth Joseph, Fawaz Mansoor, Hasratsinghchauhan
